stem:
There are 4 books on a shelf. In the model the shaded books represent nonfiction books.
Which expression represents the fraction of the books on the shelf that are nonfiction?
visual_elements: Image showing 4 books on a shelf, 3 shaded and 1 white. Shaded books represent nonfiction books.
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires simple identification of fractions and counting to determine the fraction of nonfiction books, no complex calculations.
